findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, second reading (House roll call 758, passed 66-47)
findings.note: Branson is listed among the members voting aye. The ratified bill (text at https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) requires a county board to process a voter registration application only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a U.S. citizen, with a 30-day mail-back notice and a statement under penalty of perjury if the answer is blank, and directs the State Board to set up a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database.
subjects: citizenship statement on voter registration
voter-roll checks against federal databases
non-citizen voting
election law changes in general

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, motion 11 to concur with the Senate version (House roll call 801, passed 62-47)
findings.note: Branson is listed among the members voting aye on the final concurrence vote. The bill does not add a photo-ID rule; its identity-related parts are the citizenship statement on registration forms and removal of flagged non-citizens from the rolls.
